artifacts.summary: Two-phase plan (1.3h) adding --stack/--only/--retarget stack mode to commands/merge.md, then redeploying the source store.

memory_candidates.content: When a phase's deliverable is a single documented-contract file (a slash-command .md, a skill contract, a standards doc) whose own verification criterion is internal consistency -- argument hint, options table and step list agreeing -- the phase cannot be decomposed into per-site sub-steps without committing a state that fails its own criterion. The correct decomposition is one green sub-step covering every edit site in the file, with the sub-step granularity moved instead to the phase boundary (content edit | redeploy/verify). This is the inverse of the usual multi-file guidance and is easy to get wrong when a plan mechanically splits by edit site.
